items.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued October 25 at 3:43AM EDT until October 28 at 2:00PM EDT by NWS Newport/Morehead City NC
items.description:
* WHAT...Up to 1 to 3 feet of inundation above ground level in
low- lying areas near shorelines and tidal waterways.

* WHERE...Areas along Bogue Banks beaches, Bogue Sound, the
Newport and White Oak Rivers, and adjacent tidal creeks.

* WHEN...Until 2 PM EDT Wednesday.

* IMPACTS...Up to 1 to 3 feet of inundation above ground level is
possible in some areas near shorelines and tidal waterways
resulting in a low threat of property damage. Some roads and low
lying property including parking lots, parks, lawns, and homes
adjacent to the waterfront will experience shallow flooding.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Tide levels will continue to rise with a
King Tide Cycle in place through the upcoming work-week. The
morning high tide will be the highest of the two daily tides.
King Tides peak Tuesday and Wednesday.
items.instruction:
If travel is required, allow extra time as some roads may be
closed. Do not drive around barricades or through water of
unknown depth. Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone
property.

items.headline: Gale Warning issued October 25 at 12:30AM EDT until October 25 at 8:00PM EDT by NWS Newport/Morehead City NC
items.description:
* WHAT...Northeast winds 20 to 30 kt with gusts up to 35 kt and
seas 6 to 9 ft.

* WHERE...The coastal waters from Cape Lookout to Surf City.

* WHEN...Until 8 PM EDT this evening.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds will cause hazardous seas which could
capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.
items.instruction:
Mariners should alter plans to avoid these hazardous conditions.
Remain in port, seek safe harbor, alter course, and/or secure the
vessel for hazardous conditions.
